social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Waiver move out of the Dawgs camp: Mekhi picks up the Packers D/ST and lets the Falcons D/ST go. Week 10 hasn't kicked off yet, so this is all about the matchup he's chasing.

social.author: Cheesehead Carla
social.text: Mekhi grabbing the Packers D/ST on a Wednesday like it's a normal Tuesday. Waiver king doing waiver king things, Randy still can't say anything nice about it.

social.author: Dawgs
social.text: Welcome to the squad, Packers D/ST. The Falcons D/ST gave us two points and a handshake. Thanks for the time.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Randy has cleared out Mike Evans, Stefon Diggs, Cameron Dicker and the Browns D/ST in one sitting, and is bringing in Darren Waller and two new defenses. Nothing has been played yet, so this is all roster shuffling for Ghostu-Spider SZN week.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Luffy moved The fumblers from 55% to 90% and not one point has been scored. That's the lineup work, not a play. I'm not going to argue with a jump that size.

social.author: Gridiron Gary
social.text: Randy just dropped Mike Evans AND Stefon Diggs on the same night and the guy still won't trade a single Bears player. Absolute cardiac cleanup, I need to lie down.

social.author: Zilgit Zealots
social.text: Randy cut two receivers and picked up a tight end who scored 5 points in four weeks, and Luffy loves it? Zoe, please go make him regret this.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Sonny has cut Lamar Jackson loose and picked up Corey Kiner. Jackson put up 79.1 points over eight weeks, and Sonny is going with C.J. Stroud at quarterback against the Dawgs.

social.author: Boston Brian
social.text: Sonny dropped Lamar Jackson for a running back who has zero points in one week. Maybe it's a master plan, maybe the Civ brain has taken over, but I can't tell which and I'm watching anyway.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Ramon cutting Jason Myers (75 points over nine weeks) is a real decision, and Brandon Aubrey is already in the lineup. Nothing has been played yet, so Luffy has No Banner only HULK at 87% against Habibsters.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Mekhi has swapped again: Dolphins D/ST in, Packers D/ST out, just hours after he picked the Packers up. Nothing has been played yet, so this is a pure Thursday change of heart ahead of Dawgs vs The Horse is Hea.

social.author: Cheesehead Carla
social.text: Mekhi added the Packers D/ST and dropped it before it ever played a snap. That's the shortest tenure in Green Bay history and I'm taking it personally.

social.author: Dawgs
social.text: Welcome to the squad, Dolphins D/ST. Packers D/ST, you were with us for a very brief and memorable stretch.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Luffy took The fumblers from 90% down to 61% against Ghostu-Spider SZN and nobody has scored. The swing is all lineup and injury news. Randy's lineup was given a big boost earlier, and now Luffy is taking some of it back.

social.author: Zilgit Zealots
social.text: Zoe swapped the Broncos D/ST for Cam Little and the kicker has 56 points in seven weeks. Fine, I see it, the kicker is the move nobody saw coming.

social.author: Band Camp Brad
social.text: JMoney cut Michael Wilson and brought in Khalil Shakir and Wan'Dale Robinson in the same sitting. That's a whole receiver room rebuilt before kickoff and I respect the chaos.

social.author: Counting or not Counting GV
social.text: Welcome to the squad, Khalil Shakir. He slots straight into the starting lineup against Team Pillbert.
